200.description: The site's full layout, as nested JSON or as an SVG floor plan depending on the `format` query parameter.

schema.description: The full nested, drawable structure of one Site: zones → aisles → slots, pre-grouped and pre-ordered for direct rendering. Also carries the site's fixed structures (ADR-0017): walls, columns, offices, and other physical obstacles that are not locations.

site.description: A physical facility/building — the root of the location hierarchy.

siteCode.description: Uppercase alphanumeric code, unique across the service.

status.description: The lifecycle state shared by every structural aggregate. Decommission is one-way in v1. UnderMaintenance is a legal persisted state that the read models render; no v1 use case sets it.
status.title: Status

site.title: Site

zones.description: The site's zones, ordered by zone id.

items.description: One Zone and every Aisle inside it, in walk order.

siteCode.description: The Site this zone is scoped to.

temperatureClass.description: A zone's thermal behaviour. PlacementRules match on it.
temperatureClass.title: TemperatureClass

hazmat.description: Whether the zone is rated for hazardous materials.

status.description: The lifecycle state shared by every structural aggregate. Decommission is one-way in v1. UnderMaintenance is a legal persisted state that the read models render; no v1 use case sets it.
status.title: Status

aisles.description: The zone's aisles, in SequenceHint walk order.

items.description: One Aisle and every LocationSlot inside it, ordered bay → level → position.

zoneId.description: The Zone this aisle is scoped to.

direction.description: Whether an aisle may be traversed in one direction only or both.
direction.title: Direction

status.description: The lifecycle state shared by every structural aggregate. Decommission is one-way in v1. UnderMaintenance is a legal persisted state that the read models render; no v1 use case sets it.
status.title: Status

slots.description: The aisle's slots, ordered bay → level → position.

items.description: The coded leaf location. Its identity IS its LocationCode. It owns whether the code exists, is active, and is legal for a given kind of storage unit — never what is stored in it.

zoneId.description: The Zone the code resolves to.

aisleId.description: The Aisle the code resolves to.

coordinates.description: A LocationCode exploded into its seven typed segments, so a renderer can position a slot without re-parsing the code.

area.description: Coarse functional area (STOR, RCV, PACK, STAGE).

zone.description: Behavioral class within the area (AMB, CHL, FRZ, HAZ, FWD, RSV).

coordinates.title: Coordinates

role.description: What a location on the map is FOR (ADR-0016). Storage is the default and only role that existed before this ADR; the rest cover non-storage functional locations that previously had no place on the map at all.
role.title: LocationRole

dockFlow.description: Set only when role is Dock (ADR-0016).

activities.description: Set only when role is WorkCenter (ADR-0016).

capacity.description: A capacity envelope as it appears on a READ model. Identical to Capacity except that both dimensions may be 0: a LocationType (and a slot of that type) whose role does not require capacity — Dock, Yard, WorkCenter, QC, Shipping — legitimately reports 0/0, the service's way of saying "this location holds nothing by design". Requests still use Capacity, whose dimensions are strictly positive wherever a capacity is supplied at all.
capacity.title: ResolvedCapacity

status.description: The lifecycle state shared by every structural aggregate. Decommission is one-way in v1. UnderMaintenance is a legal persisted state that the read models render; no v1 use case sets it.
status.title: Status

allOf.description: A position in the site's local coordinate frame, in metres (ADR-0017). Z must be non-negative (height above floor level).
allOf.title: Point3D

position.description: The slot's physical position, when set (ADR-0017). Absent until SetLocationGeometry is called.

allOf.description: A rectangular footprint's extent, in metres (ADR-0017). All three must be strictly positive.
allOf.title: Dimensions

dimensions.description: The slot's physical footprint, when set (ADR-0017). Absent until SetLocationGeometry is called.

items.title: LocationSlot
AisleLayout
ZoneLayout

fixedStructures.description: The site's fixed structures, ordered by id (ADR-0017).

items.description: A site-scoped physical obstacle drawn on the warehouse map — not a location; nothing can be stowed at it (ADR-0017).

kind.description: What kind of physical obstacle a FixedStructure represents (ADR-0017).
kind.title: FixedStructureKind

origin.description: A position in the site's local coordinate frame, in metres (ADR-0017). Z must be non-negative (height above floor level).
origin.title: Point3D

size.description: A rectangular footprint's extent, in metres (ADR-0017). All three must be strictly positive.
size.title: Dimensions

items.title: FixedStructure

totals.description: Counts across the whole layout, so a client can size its canvas up front.
totals.title: SiteLayoutTotals

schema.title: SiteLayout

image/svg+xml.example:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="640" height="240" viewBox="0 0 640 240">
  <title>WH1 facility layout</title>
</svg>

400.description: Malformed input: a body that is not valid JSON, a location code that is not seven `[A-Z0-9]` segments, a missing required identifier, or a query parameter outside its documented enum.

schema.description: RFC 7807 Problem Details. Every error response in this API uses this shape.

type.description: A URI identifying the error CATEGORY. It is an identifier, not a link — it does not need to resolve.

title.description: A fixed, human-readable summary of the error category.
title.example: Location type is not legal in this zone

status.description: The HTTP status code, duplicated in the body per RFC 7807.

detail.description: The specific message for this occurrence.
detail.example: location type violates a placement rule for this zone: Shelf is denied in zone WH1-STOR-FRZ by rule [RULE-FRZ-NO-SHELF: Deny Shelf where temperatureClass=Frozen]

instance.description: The request path that produced the error.

schema.title: Problem

example.title: Malformed location code
example.detail: location code must have exactly 7 hyphen-joined segments (site-area-zone-aisle-bay-level-position): got 4 segments in "WH1-STOR-AMB-A07"
